brief: Your second act with AI. For founders in their 30s and 40s feeling behind. Why AI is the great equalizer for the experienced and the patient.

slots.subtitle: For experienced founders feeling behind, artificial intelligence is the great equalizer you have earned.
slots.preview1: Why patience beats speed in the AI era
slots.preview2: The unfair advantage of decades of context
slots.preview3: How to ship product number five with AI

slots.title: You are not
slots.subtitle: The AI wave feels built for twenty-somethings, but experience is compound interest.
slots.insight1Body: You have seen two bubbles, three recessions, and know what sticks.
slots.insight2Body: Young founders raise to burn; you raise to build.
slots.insight3Body: Your rolodex took fifteen years to build; AI just made it lethal.
slots.pullQuote: The best time to start with AI was five years ago. The second best time is after you know what actually works.

slots.title: Patience is
slots.subtitle: AI rewards the founders who know which problem to solve, not just how to code.
slots.insight1Body: Writing great prompts requires judgment you cannot download.
slots.insight2Body: Your industry context turns generic models into category winners.
slots.insight3Body: One thoughtful feature beats ten AI demos every time.
slots.pullQuote: AI doesn't replace judgment; it amplifies it. And judgment is what you have in spades.

slots.title: Build with
slots.subtitle: A three-part operating system for experienced founders shipping in 2026.
slots.insight1Body: Use AI for boilerplate, emails, and tests; keep your brain for strategy.
slots.insight2Body: Voice-to-code tools cut build time by half for founders who know the architecture.
slots.insight3Body: AI writes drafts; you decide what ships and why.
slots.pullQuote: I stopped writing code and started directing it. My output tripled overnight.

slots.title: Shipped in
slots.subtitle: How I shipped my most profitable product using AI and fifteen years of market scars.
slots.insight1Body: I validated demand manually before writing a single line of AI-generated code.
slots.insight2Body: Cursor built the interface; I focused on pricing and positioning.
slots.insight3Body: No Product Hunt blast, just direct outreach to fifty qualified prospects.
slots.pullQuote: My quietest launch became my most profitable product. Experience taught me restraint.

slots.title: Play the
slots.subtitle: Speed is a trap. AI gives the patient founder an asymmetric advantage over hype.
slots.insight1Body: New models drop weekly; your strategy should not.
slots.insight2Body: One AI workflow today becomes a competitive moat by winter.
slots.insight3Body: The founders who win are curators, not just consumers, of AI output.
slots.pullQuote: I don't chase every new model. I chase one better decision every single day.

slots.title: Start this
slots.subtitle: Three concrete moves for the experienced founder ready to ship with AI today.
slots.insight1Body: List five weekly tasks you hate; one is already automatable with AI.
slots.insight2Body: Build one tiny utility in a weekend using Cursor or Replit.
slots.insight3Body: Share one AI workflow on LinkedIn; teaching sharpens taste faster than secrecy.
slots.pullQuote: The second act isn't a comeback. It's an upgrade you were patient enough to earn.

slots.ctaBody: Your experience is the moat. AI is just the leverage you were waiting for. Ship product five this quarter.
